Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the creation of a "Washington Made" logo.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a "Washington Made" logo; adding a newsection to chapter 43.31 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 43.46RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.31 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of community, trade, and economic development shallwork with economic development councils, chambers of commerce, theeconomic development commission, industry organizations, and tradeorganizations to incorporate within the existing marketing campaign,the "Washington Made" logo adopted under section 2 of this act. Thedepartment shall also work with these organizations to secure privatefunding and other public funds to assist in the educational campaign.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The arts commission shall conduct a competition for the designof a "Washington Made" logo for the voluntary labeling of consumer p. 1 SHB 2104goods produced in Washington. The eligibility requirements for thecompetition, the members of the selection committee, the competitionrules, and other details shall be established by the commission. (2) The trademark rights to the winning "Washington Made" logoshall be vested in the state of Washington. (3) In subsequent years, if the commission, in conjunction with thedepartment of community, trade, and economic development, determinesthat it is costeffective to issue a different logo, a competition forthe logo design shall be conducted in the same manner as the originalcompetition.
